# YT-DLP GUI

> Free, open-source desktop app that wraps yt-dlp and FFmpeg so video editors can download YouTube, Instagram and Twitch media without the command line. Default output is H.264/AAC MP4 that Premiere Pro, After Effects and DaVinci Resolve open without converting.

## What it is

YT-DLP GUI is an MIT-licensed Electron app for Windows (installer), macOS and Linux (run from source). Downloads run locally on the user's computer. There is no account, no telemetry and no ads. Made by Birol Softa (https://birol.tech).

## Who it's for

- Video editors who need Premiere-ready MP4, audio, subtitles or GIFs
- Creators saving YouTube, Instagram and Twitch reference clips
- yt-dlp users who want a GUI with live terminal output and auto-updated dependencies

## Tools (one tab each)

- Video: YouTube videos and whole playlists up to 4K; MP4 (H.264/AAC, default), MKV or WebM. Other links are passed to yt-dlp, which supports many more sites
- Audio: MP3 (LAME V0), M4A, WAV (16-bit PCM) or FLAC
- Subtitles: SRT or VTT in one language or all available, without downloading the video
- Instagram: Reels and posts as MP4, or audio as MP3
- Video Clipper: preview a video, set in/out points, download only that section
- Twitch VODs: past broadcasts, highlights and clips; resolution picker, chapter chips, in/out trimming, audio-only option
- Video Divider: fast split, frame-accurate split, equal chunks, spatial crop
- Video to GIF: trim, frame rate and width controls, local FFmpeg export
- Music Finder: identify songs in a video via AcoustID or ACRCloud (free API key required)
- Browser: in-app browser with media detection and cookie passthrough, so members-only or age-restricted videos the user can watch can be saved
- Recents: history with thumbnails; drag finished files into editing apps
- Settings: save folders, six accent themes, browser cookies or cookies.txt, yt-dlp release channel (stable, nightly, master), automatic yt-dlp and FFmpeg updates on every launch, Force Update
